* '''Playtest''' ([[Kamino (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kamino-20190801.gif]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e26d0f17caf92a539eec936d4c615319fce9f423/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kamino.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Kamino site.” Dark Side: “If opponent has two clones on table, Force drain -1 here.” The lower-left margin prints “Malastare (Light)”.
* '''Original''' ([[Kamino]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-kamino-20190802.gif]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/d24ffc32ae83edd646b732a344ac7e822ee55271/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/kamino.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Kamino site.” Dark Side: “If opponent has two clones on table, Force drain -1 here.” '''What changed:''' before release: the lower-left margin (underlying card) “Malastare (Light)” became “Aquaris”; re-rendered with sharper graphics; same words.
*: [[File:V11-L-kamino-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
